{{Short description|35th season of the second-tier football league in Argentina}} {{Infobox football league season |competition= [[Primera B Nacional|Primera Nacional]] |season = 2019–20 |dates = {{nowrap|15 August 2019 – 28 April 2020}} |winners = ''None; abandoned'' |promoted = |relegated = |league topscorer= [[Pablo Magnín]] (15 goals) |biggest home win= |biggest away win= |highest scoring= |matches= 333 |total goals= 691 |longest wins= |longest unbeaten= |longest losses= |prevseason= [[2018–19 Primera B Nacional|2018–19]] |nextseason= [[2020 Primera B Nacional|2020]] }} The '''2019–20 Argentine Primera B Nacional''', also known as the '''2019–20 Primera Nacional''',{{cite web|url=https://www.afa.com.ar/es/posts/sorteo-torneo-primera-nacional-primera-b-nacional-2019/2020-en-ezeiza |title=Hoy, a partir de las 16.30, se realizará el sorteo Torneo Primera Nacional (Primera "B" Nacional) 2019/2020 en Ezeiza |publisher=AFA |language=es |date=29 July 2019 |access-date=17 February 2020}} was the 35th season of the [[Primera B Nacional]], the second tier of [[Football in Argentina|Argentine]] football. The season began on 15 August 2019 and was scheduled to end in May 2020. Thirty-two teams compete in the league, twenty-one returning from the [[2018–19 Primera B Nacional|2018–19 season]], four teams that were relegated from [[2018–19 Argentine Primera División|Primera División]], two teams promoted from [[Torneo Federal A|Federal A]] and five from [[Primera B Metropolitana|B Metropolitana]]. Due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina|COVID-19 pandemic]], the [[Argentine Football Association]] suspended the tournament on 17 March 2020.{{cite web|url=https://www.afa.com.ar/es/posts/comunicado1703|title=Suspensión del fútbol|publisher=AFA|language=es|date=17 March 2020|access-date=28 April 2020}} On 28 April 2020 AFA announced the abandonment of the competition as well as the culmination of the 2019–20 season in all of its leagues, with no clubs promoted or relegated. AFA also announced that a decision on a suitable method for promotion from the Primera Nacional and lower tiers would be reached in due time.{{cite web|url=https://www.tycsports.com/superliga/el-comunicado-completo-de-la-afa-con-las-decisiones-por-el-coronavirus-20200428.html|title=El comunicado completo de la AFA con las decisiones por el coronavirus|publisher=TyC Sports|date=28 April 2020}} ==Club information== === Stadia and locations === {{location map+ |Argentina |float=right |width=300 |caption=Locations of the 2019–20 Primera B Nacional teams outside [[Greater Buenos Aires]]. |places= {{location map~ |Argentina |lat=-34.603611 |long=-58.381667 |label=
